scientificStandards.scope: Specific Migration Limits (SML) for plastic food contact materials and standardized testing simulants (A, B, C, D1, D2, E).
Indirect food additives: polymers, adhesives, coatings, and migration thresholds under Good Manufacturing Practice.
Metals and alloys used in food contact materials and articles, defining Specific Release Limits (SRL) for Al, Pb, Cd, Ni.
Tolerable Daily Intake (TDI) re-evaluation for Bisphenol A set at 0.2 ng/kg body weight/day, reflecting profound immunotoxicity.

simulants.name: Acidic Liquid (pH < 4.5)
simulants.commonFoods: Tomato sauce, vinegar dressings, citrus juice, marinara, coffee, wine
simulants.corrosiveness: High chemical chelation; aggressively leaches metal ions (Pb, Al, Cd) and hydrolyzes ester/amide polymer bonds.

simulants.name: Fatty / Lipophilic Matrix
simulants.commonFoods: Olive oil, melted cheese, butter, tallow, fatty meats, cream gravies
simulants.corrosiveness: Acts as active organic solvent; extracts non-polar lipophilic additives (ortho-phthalates DEHP/DINP, PFAS, slip agents).

simulants.name: Neutral Aqueous Medium
simulants.standard: Simulant A (10% Ethanol or Distilled Water)
simulants.commonFoods: Drinking water, clear broths, whole milk, herbal teas, cooked rice
simulants.corrosiveness: Moderate hydrolytic swelling; extracts water-soluble polar monomers, salts, and catalyst residues.

simulants.name: Hydroalcoholic Solution
simulants.commonFoods: Wine, cocktails, cooking spirits, alcoholic marinades
simulants.corrosiveness: Enhances polymer matrix swelling and accelerates monomer diffusion across hydrophobic barriers.

temperaturePresets.label: Warm Hold / Hot Serving (60°C / 140°F)
temperaturePresets.context: Buffet warmers, hot soup in bowls

materials.name: Polycarbonate (PC) Food Container
materials.smlStandard: EU 10/2011 SML (0.05 mg/kg); Banned in EU/US infant feeding bottles
materials.mechanism: Hydrolysis of carbonate ester linkages accelerated by heat and alkaline/acidic dishwashing detergents.
materials.toxicityClass: Potent Endocrine Disruptor (Xenoestrogen), Epigenetic Modifier, Immune Toxicity
materials.typicalCrossover: Exceeds EU SML in ~45 minutes at 100°C with acidic contents; safe for ~21 days at 4°C.
materials.swapRecommendation: Borosilicate Glass containers or 18/10 Medical Grade Stainless Steel

materials.name: Plasticized PVC Cling Wrap
materials.smlStandard: EU 10/2011 SML (1.5 mg/kg); Prohibited in EU food contact for fatty foods
materials.mechanism: Phthalates are not covalently bound to PVC matrix; easily solubilized and extracted by dietary lipids.
materials.toxicityClass: Reproductive Toxicant (Category 1B), Anti-Androgenic, Liver Peroxisome Proliferator
materials.typicalCrossover: Crosses 1.5 mg/kg threshold within 12 minutes in contact with hot cheese or oily meats at 60°C+.
materials.swapRecommendation: Organic Beeswax Food Wraps, Unbleached Parchment, or Platinum Silicone Lids

materials.name: Polypropylene (PP #5) Microwave Bowl
materials.smlStandard: EU 10/2011 Overall Migration Limit (10 mg/dm² ~ 60 mg/kg food)
materials.mechanism: Localized microwave dielectric heating creates thermal spikes >120°C, causing polymer chain scission and microplastic shedding.
materials.toxicityClass: Intestinal Epithelial Translocation, Vascular Endothelial Inflammation, Organ Accumulation
materials.typicalCrossover: Releases up to 4.2 million microplastics/cm² in 3 min microwave cycle; oligomers breach 10 mg/dm² in extended high heat.
materials.swapRecommendation: Thermal Shock-Resistant Borosilicate Glass or White Ceramic Dishes

materials.name: Traditional Lead-Glazed Ceramic Dish
materials.smlStandard: FDA Action Level (0.5 µg/mL for small hollowware); EU Directive 84/500/EEC
materials.mechanism: Acidic food liquids leach lead monoxide fluxes that were underfired (<1000°C) during artisan pottery firing.
materials.toxicityClass: Severe Neurotoxin, Irreversible IQ Reduction in Children, Nephrotoxicity, Cardiovascular Toxicity
materials.typicalCrossover: Breaches FDA 0.5 µg/mL safety limit in under 20 minutes when holding hot tomato soup or citrus vinaigrette.
materials.swapRecommendation: Certified Lead/Cadmium-Free Vitrified Stoneware or 304/316 Stainless Steel

materials.name: Melamine-Formaldehyde Tableware
materials.smlStandard: EU 10/2011 SML (2.5 mg/kg melamine; 15 mg/kg formaldehyde)
materials.mechanism: Thermoset resin depolymerizes rapidly in contact with temperatures >70°C and acidic foods.
materials.toxicityClass: Renal Toxicity, Kidney Stone Formation (Melamine Cyanurate), Carcinogenic Formaldehyde Offgassing
materials.typicalCrossover: Exceeds 2.5 mg/kg EU SML within 15 minutes of serving boiling soup (>85°C). Never microwave melamine.
materials.swapRecommendation: Porcelain Tableware, Tempered Glass (Opal), or Enamel-Coated Steel

materials.name: Black Nylon Cooking Utensils
materials.smlStandard: EU Commission Regulation No 284/2011: Strict non-detectable limit (0.002 mg/kg detection limit)
materials.mechanism: Degradation of thermal stabilizer azo dyes and polyamide-6,6 oligomers at cooking contact temps >100°C.
materials.toxicityClass: Group 2B / 1 Known Carcinogen, Mutagenic, DNA Adduct Former
materials.typicalCrossover: Crosses the 0.002 mg/kg carcinogen threshold in <5 minutes when resting in a simmering tomato meat sauce.
materials.swapRecommendation: Solid European Beechwood Spoons, High-Heat Solid Platinum Silicone Spatulas

materials.name: Uncoated Aluminum Cookware
materials.smlStandard: Council of Europe Resolution CM/Res(2013)9: SRL of 1.0 mg/kg food
materials.mechanism: Acidic foods dissolve the superficial aluminum oxide passivation layer, accelerating galvanic metal ion release.
materials.toxicityClass: Neurotoxicity Risk, Bone Mineral Density Depletion, Dialysis Encephalopathy Syndrome
materials.typicalCrossover: Cooking tomato sauce or rhubarb in raw aluminum exceeds 1.0 mg/kg SRL within 25 minutes of boiling.
materials.swapRecommendation: Tri-Ply Clad Stainless Steel (304/316 interior) or Enameled Cast Iron (Le Creuset style)

materials.name: Scratched Non-Stick (PTFE) Pan
materials.smlStandard: US EPA Drinking Water Health Advisory (0.004 ppt); EU REACH Proposed Universal PFAS Restriction
materials.mechanism: Mechanical gouges expose the primer layer; heat cycles >200°C cause fluoropolymer thermal degradation.
materials.toxicityClass: Forever Chemical Bioaccumulation, Thyroid Disruption, Kidney & Testicular Cancer, Immune Suppression
materials.typicalCrossover: Scratched surface sheds up to 9,100 microplastics per scrape; heats >230°C release volatile perfluorinated acids instantly.
materials.swapRecommendation: Seasoned Carbon Steel Skillet or Raw Cast Iron (Lodge)
